summary.text: Jay Block is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 12 in Bernalillo and Sandoval counties.
Block sits on the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee and the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Block's occupation as business owner and a district office in Rio Rancho.
Between sessions, Block is a member of the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee, the Legislative Health and Human Services Committee and the Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee.
